metadata.title: When Paper Trails Meet DNA: The Full Conversation with Professor Turi King and  Neil Fraser
metadata.author: Fraser and Fraser
metadata.shortDescription:
#DNA #Genealogy #FamilyHistory #Probate #HeirHunters #Inheritance #GeneticGenealogy #AI #ForensicGenealogy #FraserAndFraser

What happens when cutting-edge DNA science meets the world of genealogy and probate research?

Join Professor Turi King—renowned for identifying the remains of King Richard III—and Neil Fraser, Partner at Fraser and Fraser, for the full conversation from our When Paper Trails Meet DNA event at The London Archives.

Together, they explore the power and limitations of DNA testing, the ethical dilemmas surrounding inheritance, the rise of consumer DNA kits, privacy concerns, the future of AI in genealogy, and why traditional paper trails remain essential in tracing rightful heirs and beneficiaries.

Whether you're passionate about family history, genetics, probate, or emerging technology, this fascinating discussion offers unique insights into how science and genealogy are shaping the future of inheritance research.

🔔 Subscribe to Fraser and Fraser for more interviews, genealogy insights, probate expertise, and behind-the-scenes stories from the world of heir tracing.
